concept.title: Exercise and dance classes
concept.shortdesc: Taking part in fitness, exercise, dance, martial arts and outdoor activity classes and sessions, including seated and gentle options and gym use.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Taking part in Zumba and Zumba Gold dance fitness classes.
: Taking part in Pilates classes, including mat, chair and reformer Pilates, with some mixed yoga and Pilates classes.
: Taking part in Tai Chi and Qigong classes and sessions, including seated versions.
: Taking part in boxing, boxercise-style and kickboxing sessions and classes, including women-only sessions.
: Taking part in martial arts classes such as karate and kung fu, and self-defence training.
: Taking part in ballet classes, including adult beginner to advanced and graded classes, and adult tap dance classes.
: Taking part in exercise classes and groups done sitting on a chair.
: Taking part in running, jogging and run-walk groups and timed events, with some other outdoor sports such as horse riding and triathlon.
: Taking part in cycle rides, cycling groups, adapted cycling and bike maintenance, with some other riding and hobby activities.
: Taking part in gentle exercise, dance, circuit and aerobic classes designed to be low impact.
: Taking part in dance sessions for enjoyment, including line dancing, sequence dancing, circle dancing and general dance and movement.
: Taking part in exercise classes and groups done from a seated position, including gentle movement and strengthening.
: Taking part in exercise classes aimed at building strength, balance, mobility and flexibility, often for older people.
: Using a gym, fitness studio or weights equipment, and exercising or working out in gym-style fitness settings.
: Taking part in general group fitness or exercise classes, such as circuits, functional fitness and keep-fit.
